headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback in a closely contested matchup against the Milwaukee Brewers, edging them out 7-6. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In another Pirates-Brewers matchup, the Pirates took down the Brewers 3-2, with Valdez leading the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Chris Martin (Texas Rangers), Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds), William Kempner (Miami Marlins), Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Mike Yastrzemski (Atlanta Braves), Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins), and Nick Kurtz (Athletics). These injuries may impact their teams' lineups and pitching rotations.

The MLB saw several trades and roster movements, including the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, marking their loss in the matchup. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 14-5 victory. Impact players for the Pirates included Nick Gonzales and Jacob Gonzalez, while Jackson Chourio and Ryan O'Hearn led the Brewers' offense.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Kansas City Royals 8-2, handing them a tough loss. Impact players for the Orioles included Gunnar Henderson and Lane Thomas, while Seth Lugo and Shane Baz led the pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Shewmake Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Braden Shewmake to their roster, acquired in a trade from the Houston Astros. Shewmake joins the Brewers' infield, bolstering the team's depth.
